title: EverFoams Womens Fuzzy Open-toe Slippers Memory Foam Indoor House Shoes

You can enjoy a cup of coffee in your bedroom at home with your feet relaxing in these cozy slippers

Non-slip Sole: These fuzzy slippers can make you ease into various occasions. With anti-skid grips for good traction, the sturdy outsole is perfect whether you're picking up around the house, shopping in the market, or grabbing the morning paper

Size Tips & Delicate Gifts: If you have a standard or thin foot type, choose your usual size. For wider or higher feet, it's recommended to go one size up for extra comfort.
